title: Emit Hadamard CSR directly without rematerializing streamed intersections
finding: G1-TENSOR-01BD removed duplicate input maps from TypedRelationBlock.hadamard, but the streamed row-major intersections were still accumulated into a Python coordinate dictionary and then passed through _derived/_from_indexed, which sorted and rebuilt data that was already in canonical CSR order. This left a redundant full-result materialization and sort on the bounded reference path.
primary_claim: The reference Hadamard contraction now appends non-zero intersections directly to canonical CSR offsets, column indices, and values while scanning the already-sorted rows. It preserves the same Fourfold subject, semiring, typed-axis, zero-elision, and operation-limit contracts and bypasses _from_indexed only for this naturally ordered result path.
gardener_decision: Reuse the canonical ordering guaranteed by CSR and the existing TypedRelationBlock constructor. Delete the transient result dictionary plus _derived/_from_indexed sort/reindex pass from Hadamard; do not add a second builder, planner, cache, alternate block type, iterator layer, or cost-model abstraction.
acceptance: Hadamard emits canonical CSR row offsets and strictly increasing column indices directly, including an empty result row
Hadamard completes even when _from_indexed is forbidden after its operands are constructed
non-intersection scalar values remain unread and max_operations remains fail-closed
Fourfold subject, semiring, identical typed-axis, zero-elision, and persisted block validation remain unchanged
no OwnerApproval, promotion, gate transition, measured memory-speedup, or benchmark superiority claim is created

observed_jobs: contracts (3.12, 0): success with bounded Tensor/Forest diagnostic
verification.claim: Hosted CI is claimed only for the exact code/test revision above. Repository-wide evidence is collection-only, not a full-suite execution claim. Direct CSR emission is a structural materialization/sort reduction; no memory-speedup or benchmark superiority is inferred without measurement.

rollback: Revert the G1-TENSOR-01BE commits; Forest/Fourfold authority, persisted relation-block wire contracts, semiring semantics, and public product surfaces remain unchanged.
